# FDG9154

> DO prefer the name “source” for the input buffer parameter of methods that accept an output buffer and a single input buffer.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.12 Operating on Buffers.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

The text has no body; the body of FDG9155 explains both. Not machine-checkable: the body keeps the existing name of the source parameter of a buffer-writing variant and allows a name that clarifies the role (data and hash in RSA), so which name is best is judgment. FDG9156 checks the position of a parameter named source.
